description: React component for language selection dropdown in header, managing language list visibility, accessibility, and navigation.

methods.name: LanguageList
methods.description: React functional component for language selection dropdown with accessibility and navigation handling.

methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the language list.

methods.description: Closes the language list when clicking outside.

methods.name: closeAndFocus
methods.description: Closes the list and sets focus back to toggle button with visual feedback.
